$comment: Single source of truth for the Privasys X.509 OID scheme v2 (RA-TLS v2). Every SDK constant table, the wallet's TypeScript table and docs/oids.md are generated from this file by `cd go && go run ./cmd/oidgen -root ..`. CI runs the same command with -check. Rules: one slot, one meaning, on both editions; numbers are contiguous within an arc; a retired slot is never reused; evidence (quotes, GPU evidence) is never a certificate extension in v2; the app-defined sub-arc root (5.4) never carries a literal value.

quote_extensions.name: SGX_QUOTE
quote_extensions.label: SGX Quote
quote_extensions.note: Intel arc. A v1 certificate extension; in v2 the quote travels in the attest response and a leaf that carries it is a v1 leaf (rejected).

quote_extensions.name: TDX_QUOTE
quote_extensions.label: TDX Quote
quote_extensions.note: Intel arc. Same status as SGX_QUOTE.

extensions.label: Runtime Version Hash

extensions.name: IMAGE_PROFILE

extensions.encoding: UTF-8 string, "production" or "dev"

extensions.name: ENCLAVE_INSTANCE_ID
extensions.label: Enclave Instance ID

extensions.name: PLATFORM_HARDWARE_IDENTITY
extensions.label: Platform Hardware Identity
extensions.encoding: reserved for Platform Ownership Endorsements

extensions.name: CONFIG_MERKLE_ROOT
extensions.label: Config Merkle Root
extensions.encoding: 32 bytes, root over every configuration input of the platform

extensions.name: EGRESS_CA_HASH
extensions.label: Egress CA Bundle Hash
extensions.encoding: 32 bytes, SHA-256 of the outbound trust-anchor bundle

extensions.name: ATTESTATION_SERVERS_HASH
extensions.label: Attestation Servers Hash

extensions.name: COMBINED_WORKLOADS_HASH

extensions.name: DEK_ORIGIN

extensions.name: AUTHENTICATED_STATE_ROOT

extensions.name: WORKLOAD_APP_ID

extensions.encoding: 16-byte UUID, the management app id

extensions.name: WORKLOAD_CODE_HASH

extensions.name: WORKLOAD_IMAGE_REF
extensions.label: Workload Image Ref
extensions.encoding: UTF-8 string, image reference without digest

extensions.name: WORKLOAD_CONFIG_MERKLE_ROOT
extensions.label: Workload Config Merkle Root
extensions.encoding: 32 bytes

extensions.name: WORKLOAD_CONFIGURATION_HASH
extensions.label: Workload Configuration Hash
extensions.encoding: 32 bytes, runtime-stamped hash of the workload configuration

extensions.name: WORKLOAD_RESERVED_5_3

extensions.name: WORKLOAD_MODEL_DIGEST
extensions.label: Model Digest

extensions.name: WORKLOAD_TOOLS_DIGEST
extensions.label: Tools Digest
extensions.encoding: app-defined (SDK set-attestation-extension), 32 bytes

extensions.name: WORKLOAD_POLICY_DIGEST
extensions.label: Policy Digest
extensions.encoding: app-defined (SDK set-attestation-extension), 32 bytes, SHA-256 of the workload's active service-ceiling policy document

extensions.name: WORKLOAD_KEY_SOURCE
extensions.label: Workload Key Source
extensions.encoding: UTF-8 string, "byok:<fingerprint>", "generated" or "vault:<path>"

extensions.name: ALLOWED_CALLERS

prefixes.name: PRIVASYS_ARC_PREFIX
prefixes.label: Privasys arc
prefixes.description: The whole Privasys private-enterprise arc, with a trailing dot. Membership in CertInfo.CustomOids is by arc, not by allowlist.

prefixes.name: APP_EXTENSION_ARC_PREFIX
prefixes.label: App-defined extensions
prefixes.description: Sub-arc apps publish attested digests under, through the SDK set-attestation-extension call. Open-ended by design; the root 5.4 never carries a value.
